title: Enterprise intake scoring playbook for hosted chat streaming, tool calls, and structured outputs
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: Build a repeatable intake + prioritization playbook for enterprise-hosted API requests that involve chat streaming, tool/function calling, and structured output requirements. This ticket captures the rubric, decision rules, required artifacts, and operational handoffs so PMs can consistently triage incoming enterprise asks (non-bug). Scope excludes infra-only requests (routing to ENG backlog) and compliance-only requests (routing to Security/Compliance).
acceptance_criteria: A documented scoring rubric that scores requests on business impact, data sensitivity, risk, engineering effort, and latency/cost constraints
A one-page intake checklist for customer-facing teams capturing required artifacts: example prompts, production traffic estimates, telemetry requirements, and desired SLAs
Playbook mapping scores to outcomes: fast-track (hosted quick-turn), consult (design + eng review), dedicated evaluation (Dedicated/Private), or decline
Handoff templates for Eng, Design, Security with required fields and example links
Pilot triage of the next 6 enterprise inbound requests using the rubric and a retrospective summary
proposed_rubric: Business impact (0-5): revenue, retention, or compliance priority
Implementation complexity (0-5): API changes, streaming semantics, tool integrations
Latency/SLO risk (0-5): strict sub-second requirements or bursty traffic
Cost exposure (0-5): high token volumes, embeddings + search, or multi-model fan-out
Total mapping: 0-7 => Backlog; 8-12 => Consult; 13-20 => Fast-track or Dedicated evaluation (see notes)
playbook_decisions: If Data sensitivity >=4 -> route to Security & Private deployment team for evaluation; hosted offering may require additional controls (KMS, contract addendum)
If Latency/SLO risk >=4 AND Implementation complexity <=2 -> consider edge routing + model variant; engage ENG runtime for feasibility spike
If Tool-calling requested with external API execution -> require threat model + approval from Security and clearly defined retry/backoff semantics
Structured output (schema enforcement) requests must include example schema, failure modes, and evaluation harness; if missing, request prompt + test cases from customer
High Cost exposure with uncertain ROI -> require a cust-committed pilot or cost-share proposal before prioritization
initial_artifacts_required: Customer brief (one pager) with success metrics
Representative prompts and expected outputs (10-20 examples)
Traffic profile: QPS, burst size, percent streaming vs non-streaming
Desired SLA and roll-out plan (canary, percentage, timeline)
handoff_templates: Eng: PRD link + acceptance criteria + perf targets + spike scope
Design: UX flows for streaming/tool-call interactions + error states
Security: data flow diagram, KMS/HSM requirements, logging/audit retention
Support/CS: runbook stub + escalation path + customer comms template

decisions: Adopt a 5-dimension numeric rubric (Business Impact, Data Sensitivity, Complexity, Latency Risk, Cost Exposure) as the canonical prioritization signal
Use three operational outcomes: Backlog/Consult/Fast-track with explicit checklists for each
All tool-calling requests require a mandatory Security review and documented threat model before Eng commits
Streaming requests with strict latency targets should default to an ENG spike (2 week) to validate runtime and kernel selection feasibility
